description: 市内の駅 [railways and stations] is a dataset listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by 長浜市. 長浜市内の駅施設の情報. Coverage: 長浜市. The portal files it under the publisher 長浜市. Its tags are 位置情報, 緯度経度, 鉄道駅, 駅施設. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2026-04-20 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
